title: Quick Charred Gooey German Plum Tomatoes Risotto
description: A fast, charred, gooey ovo-vegetarian German dish featuring plum tomatoes cooked in a tandoor-clay-pot.
instructions: Heat the butter and olive oil in a preheated tandoor-clay-pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the Risotto rice and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add the white wine and stir until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Add 250ml of the vegetable broth and stir until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 250ml increments, until the rice is cooked.
Add the plum tomatoes, Parmesan cheese, and stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is gooey.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve immediately.
